words.cp: have a conviction that ... 坚信……｜carry conviction 有说服力｜convict v. 定罪

words.sent: There is a clear ___ between the two.
words.tr: 两者之间有明显的关联。
words.full: There is a clear correlation between the two.
words.alt: The study found no correlation.
words.altZh: 这项研究未发现相关性。
words.cp: correlation between A and B  A与B之间的相关性｜correlate v. 关联｜positive/negative correlation 正/负相关

words.tr: 这起丑闻损害了他的信誉。
words.full: The scandal damaged his credibility.
words.alt: The claim lacks credibility.
words.cp: damage/undermine credibility 损害信誉｜gain credibility 获得可信度｜credible adj. 可信的

words.sent: The ___ of rice needs much water.
words.tr: 种稻需要大量水。
words.full: The cultivation of rice needs much water.
words.alt: The land is under cultivation.
words.cp: under cultivation 在耕种中｜cultivate v. 耕作/培养｜cultivated adj. 有教养的

words.sent: The child is in her mother's ___.
words.tr: 孩子由母亲监护。
words.full: The child is in her mother's custody.
words.alt: He was taken into police custody.
words.cp: in custody 被拘留｜in the custody of 由……监护/保管（固定搭配）｜custodial adj. 监护的

words.sent: Prices rose, and wages were raised ___.
words.tr: 物价上涨，工资也相应提高。
words.full: Prices rose, and wages were raised accordingly.
words.alt: The rules changed; we acted accordingly.
words.altZh: 规则变了，我们据此采取了行动。
words.cp: accordingly 常置于句末，表“相应地/照着做”｜act accordingly 照此办理（高频搭配）

words.tr: 这些数字的报道并不准确。
words.full: The figures were not accurately reported.
words.alt: The clock keeps time accurately.
words.cp: accurately 修饰动词，表“准确地”｜accurate adj. 准确的｜accuracy n. 准确性

words.tr: 员工没有得到充分培训。
words.full: The staff were not adequately trained.
words.alt: The room was adequately lit.
words.cp: adequately 表“足够地/充分地”｜adequate adj. 足够的｜反义 inadequately

words.tr: 诚然，他是更优秀的选手。
words.full: admittedly, he is the better player.
words.alt: Admittedly, the plan has flaws.
words.altZh: 无可否认，这个计划有缺陷。
words.cp: admittedly 作评注性状语，用于让步（相当于“诚然”）｜admit v. 承认

words.tr: 这一变化对出口造成了不利影响。
words.full: The change affected exports adversely.
words.alt: Smoking adversely affects health.
words.cp: adversely affect 对……产生不利影响（超高频搭配）｜adverse adj. 不利的

words.sent: She is ___, the best in the field.
words.tr: 可以说她是这一领域最优秀的。
words.full: She is arguably, the best in the field.
words.alt: This is arguably the best solution.
words.altZh: 这大概是最好的解决方案。
words.cp: arguably 表示“可以说、大概”，常与最高级连用｜argue v. 论证｜argument n. 论点

words.tr: 总体而言，这个计划是成功的。
words.full: broadly, the plan has worked.
words.alt: The two views are broadly similar.
words.cp: broadly speaking 大体上说（固定搭配）｜broadly similar 大体相似｜broad adj. 宽的

words.sent: The delay was ___ due to weather.
words.tr: 延误主要是天气造成的。
words.full: The delay was chiefly due to weather.
words.alt: The book is chiefly about childhood.
words.cp: chiefly 近义 mainly、primarily｜chief adj. 主要的｜chief n. 首领

words.tr: 这次考试相对容易。
words.full: The exam was comparatively easy.
words.alt: Prices here are comparatively low.
words.cp: comparatively + 形容词 相对……（可比对象常省略）｜comparative adj. 比较的

words.sent: He lied, and ___ lost his job.
words.tr: 他撒了谎，因此丢了工作。
words.full: He lied, and consequently lost his job.
words.alt: The road was closed and consequently we were late.
words.altZh: 道路封闭，因此我们迟到了。
words.cp: consequently 表结果，常置于句首或句中｜consequence n. 后果｜consequent adj. 随之而来的

words.tr: 这一地区人口稠密。
words.full: The area is densely populated.
words.alt: The city is densely built.
words.cp: densely populated 人口稠密的（高频搭配）｜dense adj. 密集的｜density n. 密度

words.sent: He was ___ upset by the news.
words.tr: 他显然对这个消息很不安。
words.full: He was evidently upset by the news.
words.alt: Evidently, the plan had failed.
words.cp: evidently 表“显然”，近义 clearly、obviously｜evident adj. 明显的｜evidence n. 证据

words.tr: 这项任务极其困难。
words.full: The task proved exceedingly difficult.
words.alt: She was exceedingly kind to us.
words.cp: exceedingly + 形容词 极其……（语气强于 very）｜exceed v. 超过｜excessive adj. 过度的

words.tr: 这些规定明确禁止吸烟。
words.full: The rules explicitly forbid smoking.
words.alt: She explicitly denied the charge.
words.altZh: 她明确否认了这一指控。
words.cp: explicitly 表“明确地”｜explicit adj. 明确的（反义 implicit 含蓄的）｜explicitness n. 明确

words.tr: 他在亚洲游历甚广。
words.full: He travelled extensively in Asia.
words.alt: The topic has been extensively studied.
words.altZh: 这个课题已被广泛研究。
words.cp: extensively 修饰动词，表“广泛地”｜extensive adj. 广泛的（extensive damage 大面积损坏）

words.tr: 幸运的是，没有人受伤。
words.full: fortunately, nobody was hurt.
words.alt: Fortunately, the train was late.
words.cp: fortunately 作评注性状语，常置于句首｜fortunate adj. 幸运的｜反义 unfortunately

words.tr: 她经常工作到很晚。
words.full: She frequently works late.
words.alt: The bus runs frequently.
words.cp: frequently 近义 often｜frequent adj. 频繁的（作动词读 /frɪˈkwent/，指“常去”）｜frequency n. 频率

words.tr: 这两种观点根本不同。
words.full: The two views are fundamentally different.
words.alt: The system is fundamentally sound.
words.altZh: 这个体系基本上是健全的。
words.cp: fundamentally different 根本不同（高频搭配）｜fundamental adj. 根本的

words.tr: 会谈被无限期推迟。
words.full: The talks were postponed indefinitely.
words.alt: The project cannot continue indefinitely.
words.altZh: 这个项目不能无限期地继续下去。
words.cp: postpone indefinitely 无限期推迟（高频搭配）｜indefinite adj. 无限期的

words.tr: 他总是在八点前到。
words.full: He invariably arrives before eight.
words.alt: Such plans invariably fail.
words.cp: invariably 表“总是、无一例外”｜invariable adj. 不变的｜vary v. 变化
